name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceIntroduceWebViewActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects an interactive web introduction. It loads the ad's web content, tracks the required interaction, and can start its video strategy.
disableEffect: The interactive ad introduction cannot be completed, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.
